verdict.rationale: Phoenix is an observability platform with SDKs and APIs, so versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents neither API versioning nor a deprecation policy. Pinning Docker image versions and versioning prompts or datasets are adjacent features, not API versioning, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
